text.p: The following are the stories reported in Lithuanian newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The 10,000th open heart surgery was carried out in Lithuania on Wednesday.
- The deputy head of the security department Kazys Pednycha, 46, might be named as prosecutor general, newspaper sources said.
- The capitalisation of the Vilnius bourse rose to 5.63 billion litas last week versus 5.47 billion litas a week ago.
- Latvian food producers are looking for new markets in Lithuania. 35 Latvian food producers are participating in the Latfood 97 fair which opened its doors in Vilnius on Wednesday.
- The government intends to decentralise the energy sector. It is planned to pass the 1.6 billion litas assets of Lietuvos Energija to municipalities in the summer.
- Lithuanian railways with share capital of 1.2 billion litas ended 1996 with a 9.4 million litas net profit.
- The government decided on Wednesday to compensate from the budget 50 million litas to heating energy producing companies which suffered losses in January-April 1997 due to low consumer prices.
- The fashion festival In Vogue'97 will be held in Vilnius on May 1-4 in Vilnius. It is expected that fashion houses Nina Ricci, Lapidus and Max Mara will participate.
- The chairman of the council of the stock exchange Kestutis Glaveckas said that there are more than 15 companies worth including on the official trading list of Vilnius bourse, to be launched soon.
- Shall we have to call Helsinki the second Yalta, asks the newspaer in an editorial about the Helsinki summit.
- The World Lithuanian Community wants to have its representative in parliament.
